summary: Tested the Rabobank bond (XS1002121454) integration end to end: customer page /dashboard/anleihen/kaufen, admin catalog /admin/bond-catalog and admin requests /admin/bond-requests. Backend: wrote 12 pytest tests, 11 pass. The one failure is minor: PATCH that changes an ISIN to one already in use returns 500. Frontend: every requested flow passed. All 6 search terms find the card. The card shows every required value (6,500%, 108,75 % historischer Referenzwert, Unbefristet twice, Laufende Verzinsung 5,98 %, Rendite bis Fälligkeit entfällt, 1.000,00 €, risk note, reference meta line, product details with legal issuer, Stückelung 25 € and Zinstermine). Issuer filter, min/max Restlaufzeit filters, the success toast with the exact text, the below-minimum error and the duplicate 409 all work. Admin side: search, badges, visibility toggle (card disappears for the customer), requests toggle (customer button is disabled and the backend returns 400), edit modal that saves prices and records a price-history row with timestamp and an audit entry, create and delete of a TEST_ bond, duplicate ISIN 409 toast, plus note, offer (non-multiple of 25 rejected), details, cancel, approve and reject on requests. Customers get 403 on admin endpoints and /requests/me has no internal_notes. A request books nothing: no positions and no cash change. The 390px mobile view has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Changing isin to an ISIN already used by another bond returns 500, from an unhandled DuplicateKeyError on the isin_unique_sparse index. It should return 409 'Eine Anleihe mit dieser ISIN existiert bereits.' like POST does. Fix: pre-check with find_one({isin, _id: {$ne: oid}}) and/or catch DuplicateKeyError.
The minimum-investment error reads 'Mindestinvestition nicht erreicht (1000.0 EUR)'. It shows a raw float instead of German formatting (1.000 €).
The offer object is returned to the customer including created_by (the admin's email address). Consider removing created_by from the customer serializer.

ui_bugs.issue: The audit entry for offer_created shows 'offer: – → [object Object]'. Object values need formatting, e.g. price % · nominal · amount.
Status shows the raw value 'pending' instead of the German label (Offen) used in the table.

issues: Number inputs (type=number) do not accept a German decimal comma: '107,9' cannot be typed, even though toPayload handles commas. Use type=text with inputMode=decimal.
Emissionsdatum and Fälligkeitsdatum use the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy in an en-US browser) instead of the shadcn Calendar.
Kupon and Kurs use a dot as decimal separator (6.5%, 108.75%, 'Kurs bei Anfrage 108.75%'), while the customer page uses German formatting (6,500 %, 108,75 %).
Min. Volumen shows '1.000,00 €' for Rabobank but '1.000 €' (fallback string) for bonds without min_order_eur, which is slightly inconsistent.
Existing synced bonds (DEKA, DZ BANK, BUND) show Aktueller Kurs / Aktuelle Rendite / Approx. YTM as '–' because those bonds have no price data. Layout and labels are unchanged from before.

action_items: Return 409 instead of 500 when PATCH /api/admin/bonds/catalog/{id} sets a duplicate ISIN
Format the offer object in the audit list (details dialog) instead of showing [object Object]

Optional: German formatting in the min-investment error and in the admin tables; allow a decimal comma in the admin number fields; use shadcn Calendar for the date fields; hide created_by in the offer returned to customers
critical_code_review_comments: bond_catalog.admin_update_bond: no duplicate-ISIN guard, so the unique index raises DuplicateKeyError and the endpoint returns 500.

BondFormModal.toPayload sends every field on PATCH, so an admin edit always sets is_manual_override=True. This is intended, but it means any edit of a synced bond permanently stops the exchange sync from updating it.
AnleihenKaufenPage renders all ~1288 cards at once with no pagination or virtualisation. This works, but initial render is heavy.
Customer _serialize exposes the offer with the admin's email in created_by.

rca of the issue: PATCH duplicate ISIN returns 500: admin_update_bond calls find_one_and_update with the new isin and does no pre-check. The isin_unique_sparse index raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError, which is not caught. Reproduce: PATCH /api/admin/bonds/catalog/<bondA> with {isin: <bondB isin>}. Mitigation: check that the ISIN is not used by another bond (_id != oid) before updating and raise 409, and also catch DuplicateKeyError and return 409.
